title: Fernhaven Seed Library — Annual Report 2022 (extract)
text: The catalogue closed the year at 857 varieties. Twenty-eight volunteers ran the library this year; we continue to employ no paid staff. The Seedling Swap went ahead in April in fine weather. Seed lending remains free to members, who return saved seed in the autumn.
notes: First-party annual-report register. Legitimate source: precise catalogue size (857 — consistent with the almanac's 'more than eight hundred' and the magazine's 'hundreds'), volunteer staffing, festival, purpose. Its figures must never blend with the impostor's twelve thousand accessions or staff of forty.
